feedback_text: The dropoff pin defaulted to my last saved home address instead of where I actually wanted to go. I had to correct it every time.
When I switched the app to Arabic, the route preview mirrored but the car icon kept pointing the wrong direction on the road.
Prices are shown in USD even though I'm in Dubai — I had to convert to AED myself before confirming.
The 'Confirm ride' and 'Cancel' buttons are right next to each other in almost the same color — I nearly canceled by mistake.
The ETA jumped from 4 minutes to 11 with no explanation, which made me think something had gone wrong.
In dark mode, the map roads and the background are nearly the same shade of gray — hard to tell where the road actually is at night.
My saved card failed silently — the app just sat on a spinner. I didn't know if I should try again or if I'd already been charged.
After payment there's no itemized breakdown, just a total. I couldn't tell how much was the base fare vs. surge.
Half the settings menu flipped to RTL but the bottom nav icons stayed left-to-right ordered — felt broken, not intentional.
Numbers in the fare summary showed as Arabic-Indic digits in some places and Western digits in others, on the same screen.
The star rating widget is tiny and hard to tap precisely right after getting out of a moving vehicle.
There's no way to add quick feedback tags like 'safe driving' or 'clean car' — just a blank text box that feels like a lot of effort after a short ride.
I got charged a cancellation fee but the app never told me there would be one before I canceled.
After canceling, the app just showed a blank screen for a few seconds — I thought it had crashed.

task: Book a ride for someone else
feedback_text: There's no way to book a ride for a family member and share live tracking with them — I had to send screenshots over WhatsApp.
The permission requests for location, notifications and contacts all came at once — I just tapped 'allow' on everything without reading.
Onboarding assumed I already knew what 'Captain' means instead of 'driver' — took me a screen or two to realize they're the same thing.

task: Use the app during a network drop
feedback_text: My connection dropped mid-ride and when it came back, the map hadn't updated — I couldn't tell if the ride was still being tracked correctly.
